title: Registry configuration (registry.config.json)
description: Root configuration of a registry repository: how the registry is named and which module directories are not published.

legacyModuleNames.description: Module names that are exempt from the kebab-case rule. A fixed exception for names that already exist elsewhere; leave empty in a new registry.

unlisted.description: Module directories that are not published, keyed by directory name. The value says why. Unlisted modules are only checked against module.schema.json.
